title: GS21 industry sign x standardized leverage (mean zero) with a continuous firm-level debt capacity: four mirrored types on the gs_level ladder, exposure gs_bv_f b~ at loadings +-0.05 / 0.1 / 0.15, coupons drawn from [0.1, 0.9], price 2.5
question: The mean-zero version of gvyslq: does the product of the industry sign and the firm's standardized leverage, with no additive part, give GS21 room and a gap as the productivity version (gvysz2) does?
notes:

This is the mean-zero version at gvyslq's loadings. PREDICTION (2026-11-02): room 30% or more (gvysz2, the same construction on productivity: 22-66%) and a fair gap at or above +0.029. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.
